mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors adjust for reduced manufacturing activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Fed to maintain higher rates, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A negative month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a potential oversupply or inventory correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced sales velocity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines during strong consumer demand phases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to weakening economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 108.0.
